topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledgments at hire and yearly; sanctions under POL-01 4.8, with agencies told when their data is involved
Board risk committee oversees cyber and AI risk quarterly; board audit committee oversees internal audit
evidence: Committee minutes 2025-2026; 2026-09-15 approval of P01 and P07

control_description: Group CISO, division security and compliance leads, and system owners with reporting lines and authorities set in POL-01
evidence: POL-01; organization charts; SSP role table

control_description: Screening before access (POL-01 4.7); annual awareness training and program-specific training (POL-05 4.2)
gap: 31 of 120 sampled corporate staff with CJI or FTI environment access lack a fingerprint-based check or Pub. 1075 investigation for a state or program; CJIS and FTI modules not assigned to corporate staff (P07 PS-03a.; AT-02a.01[03])
remediation: Suspend unscreened access; group screening register; assign modules (POAM-001, POAM-009)

control_description: Risk and control owners named in the registers and the common control catalog; sanctions for violations
Audit logging to the group SIEM and write-once archive; system component inventories in each SSP

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Group policies published; annual training; 1-hour incident reporting rule known to staff
System description, contract security terms, status page, and named agency security contacts
evidence: System description; contracts; contract obligations register
gap: Agency security contacts and clocks not complete in the group notification matrix; support terms do not tell agency users to keep FTI and CJI out of tickets (P07 IR-06b.; SA-09b.[02])
remediation: Complete the matrix; update the support terms and system description (POAM-003, POAM-015)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set from contracts: SP 800-53 Moderate baseline, contract RTO and RPO, and FIPS 199 categorization
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment per division with roll-up to group (P01)
Insider misuse and fraud risks in the registers (GR-13)
Change risk review for major releases and organization changes (acquisitions)
Group internal audit assesses common controls yearly and samples division controls (P07)
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline and documented in the SSP and common control catalog
Technology general controls inherited from SYS-G1 to SYS-G3 and documented in the catalog

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies POL-01 to POL-05 (2026) with division supplements and procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA; encryption at rest and in transit; tenant isolation; group-managed keys
evidence: Authentication policy; encryption settings; tenant isolation tests

control_description: Users and service accounts registered and approved through identity governance before access
gap: 41 ACMP service accounts are created and managed by script outside identity governance (P07 AC-02g.)
remediation: Onboard service accounts with named owners (POAM-005)

control_description: Role-based least privilege; quarterly certification; just-in-time administrator elevation
gap: 6 dormant support accounts in the CJI cluster; service accounts left out of the Q2 certification; 23 subcontractor staff without documented Security Addendum certifications or IRS-approved terms (P07 AC-02j.; PS-07b.)
remediation: Disable dormant accounts; include service accounts in certification; suspend undocumented subcontractor access (POAM-005, POAM-012)

control_description: Physical security inherited from FedRAMP authorized cloud providers (carve-out)
evidence: Provider FedRAMP packages and SOC 2 reports reviewed 2026

control_description: Media sanitization and contract-end purge with certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Boundary protection through the landing-zone hubs; phishing-resistant MFA for remote and administrative access
gap: The directory trust to the acquired firm's directory, whose VPN accepts SMS codes, is a path into the identity platform the ACMP relies on (P07 AC-17b.)
remediation: Phishing-resistant VPN MFA; trust retired at migration (POAM-018)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encryption in transit with FIPS validated or certified modules; data movement limited by egress allow-lists
evidence: TLS scan; module inventory; egress rules
gap: FTI and CJI appeared in 14 of 300 sampled tickets in the IT service management system, outside the system boundary and the revenue agencies' IRS notifications (P07 SA-09a.[01])
remediation: Block regulated attachments; secure support channel; purge (POAM-015)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Group EDR on workloads and endpoints; signed images in the pipeline

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and configuration guardrails with remediation windows
gap: 11 high-severity container image findings past the 30-day window; 23 expired guardrail exceptions (P07 RA-05d.; CM-06c.[02])
remediation: Rebuild images and add an image age gate; expire or re-approve exceptions (POAM-013, POAM-010)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 group SOC monitoring with SIEM detections
gap: A simulated bulk read from the CJI cluster by a service account raised no alert (P07 SI-04c.01)

control_description: Security events triaged and evaluated with one group severity scale
gap: Escalation, severity handling, and closure differ between division annexes (P07 IR-04d.)
remediation: One group handling procedure with division annexes (POAM-008)

control_description: Group incident response plan, division annexes, notification matrix, and exercises
gap: Notification matrix incomplete; no cross-division exercise with agency contacts (P07 IR-06b.; IR-08a.10; IR-03)
remediation: Complete the matrix; tabletop with agency security contacts (POAM-003, POAM-004)

control_description: Recovery from incidents using immutable backups and rebuild from code
gap: Recovery of the CJI cluster and FTI tenants at scale is untested (P07 CP-10[01])
remediation: Parallel restore automation and reconstitution order (POAM-011)

control_description: Pipeline change control with peer review, testing, approval, and emergency change rules
gap: 7 of 40 sampled emergency changes lacked retrospective approval within 2 business days; no weekly review (P07 CM-03b.[02]; CM-03f.[02])

control_description: BIA (P05), contingency plans, and cyber insurance for business disruption

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor and subcontractor reviews; flowdown before data (POL-01 4.9)
gap: Subcontractor flowdown not checked for 23 staff; 2 revenue agencies' IRS notifications do not name the provider B vault; the IT service management system is not named in the notifications (P03 PB-04, PB-16)
remediation: Flowdown checklist; updated agency notifications (POAM-012, POAM-027, POAM-015)

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling across 3 availability zones
Immutable backups in the provider B vault with a separate identity and deletion lock
evidence: Vault configuration; deletion lock test (P07 CP-9 satisfied)

control_description: Recovery plan testing
evidence: Restore test reports 2025-2026 (12 tenants in 6 hours)
gap: Only per-tenant restores are tested. A full restore of about 430 tenants is estimated at more than 30 hours against the 8-hour contract RTO (P07 CP-04a.[01]; CP-10[01])
remediation: Full-scale exercise of the CJI cluster and 2 FTI tenants after the automation is built (POAM-011)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Confidential information classified and kept only where POL-04 allows; retention per contract
gap: Common control logs that hold FTI-related records are kept 2 years where Pub. 1075 requires 7; FTI and CJI in support tickets (P07 AU-11; SA-09a.[01])
